about: The public halves of the commit-signing keys of this repository's agents (Dinis Cruz, 18 and 19 Nov 2026: every agent publishes its key in the repository it maintains and signs every commit with it; PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-19-signed-commits-paid-search-and-free-embeds.md, section 2). Read by scripts/check-signatures.mjs: each commit is checked against this file as it stood in its parent. A key is revoked by removing its entry; a new session adds its own key in a commit signed by a key already listed, or a person adds it. The other key of this agent, for its signed release manifests, is in team/keys/videos-b-promptugal.json (an sgit key, not used for commits).

ssh.format: Ed25519, SPKI PEM (the check derives the OpenSSH form)

keys.how: Made with ssh-keygen (OpenSSH 9.6) in the agent's own cloud session on 19 Nov 2026; only its public half is here. It ends with the session: at hand-over its entry is removed.
